description: A biomedical engineer needs a specific anatomical model for a nasal airflow simulation. Segment the air-filled cavities (sinuses/airways) from the loaded CT Cranium dataset. Create a new mask using a custom threshold range appropriate for AIR (do NOT use bone presets; target negative Hounsfield Units, e.g., max < -100 HU). Generate a 3D surface from this mask. Change the surface color to BLUE to distinguish it for the simulation team. Save the InVesalius project to '/home/ga/Documents/airway_study.inv3'. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
